items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: It was rumored that so many of them refused to try it because Herb had -- Herbie had done such a good job on it

ctx.x: No, I think he -- his voice just fit that particular tune. In fact, the record that he made on 'Flamingo' hasn't been duplicated since or hasn't been tried too much since. It was rumored that so many of them refused to try it because Herb had -- Herbie had done such a good job on it, and they didn't care to risk it. So --
(inaudible). Why did Ivy leave the band?
